title: Count European dynamic fragment usage
changes: Expose separate request, selector-byte and payload-byte counters for dynamic raw fragments in runtime and production diagnostics.
validation: One isolated Windows build and focused Wine test on the accepted e100 dataset verified exact counters for typed selector and payload reads, a mixed edge and an outside read; guarded inputs and frozen sources were unchanged.
limitations: The actual production log and positive ordinary use remain unverified; counts include repeated reads. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
